xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: SEBI, vide order dated October 30, 2025, has prohibited Gretex Corporate Services Limited, in its capacity as a SEBI Registered Merchant Banker (INM000012177), from taking up any new assignment or contract or launching a new scheme for a period of twenty-one (21) days, pursuant to the enquiry proceedings conducted under the SEBI (Merchant Bankers) Regulations, 1992 and SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The violations pertain to non-maintenance of minimum prescribed net worth in violation of Regulation 7 of the SEBI (Merchant Bankers) Regulations, 1992, and failure to exercise adequate due diligence in respect of an SME public issue in violation of Regulation 13 read with Clauses 1, 3, 4, 7 and 20 of Schedule III of SEBI (Merchant Bankers) Regulations, 1992.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: There is no financial or operational impact on the Company, as the restriction does not affect ongoing merchant banking assignments and the Company continues to conduct all its other business activities in the normal course. The impact, if any, on new assignment revenue for this limited period is not expected to be material or quantifiable at this stage.
